title: Sentiment classification - mixed signal, negative dominates (hard)
prompt:
Classify the sentiment of this review. Respond with exactly one of: positive, negative, neutral.
Review: The build quality is excellent, but honestly the customer service ruined the whole experience for me and I'm returning it.

metadata.hard_reason: Positive opener (build quality excellent) should NOT win - the customer's actual conclusion and action (returning it) are negative; tests whether the model weighs the real verdict over the first clause.
